result.title: Controlled Binary Assignment Flows
result.summary: This paper introduces a geometric approach to the representation and learning of time-variant parametrizations of deep assignment flows, for binary data labelings on graphs. Each edge carries an optimally controlled parameter flow in a 2-dimensional totally geodesic submanifold, based on objectives derived from a non-local linear scale space representation of the input data. The aggregation of triplets of such flows in 5-dimensional totally geodesic submanifolds is learned from data. The fusion of these flows determines the trajectory in the high-dimensional symmetric parameter space and by geometric integration the layers of binary deep assignment flows. Numerical results demonstrate the expressivity and the limitation of our highly parallel geometric local synthesis approach to high-dimensional deep assignment flow parametrizations.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出图上二值标注的深度 assignment flow 的几何参数化方法：每条边在二维全测地子流形上带最优控制的参数流，三元组流在五维子流形中聚合，融合后经几何积分构成高维对称参数空间中的轨迹与网络层。
AI.relevance_reason: 「局部流融合 + 几何积分生成高维轨迹」的可并行局部合成思路，可能与 LVR 中并行/局部的 latent 状态更新如何组合成推理轨迹相关，可供核查；但该文面向图标注而非视觉推理，未涉及视觉证据与答案使用。
